security.title: Improper Initialization
security.description: The product does not initialize or incorrectly initializes a resource, which might leave the resource in an unexpected state when it is accessed or used.

evidence.explanation: Static client reference fields initially default to null. Client-construction exceptions are caught and only recorded, allowing static initialization to complete with one or both clients unset. Prerequisite: Invalid configuration or another exception during client construction. Impact: Subsequent client dereferences can fail. This is a reliability pattern, not demonstrated attacker exploitation.

security.title: Missing Release of Resource after Effective Lifetime
security.description: The product does not release a resource after its effective lifetime has ended, i.e., after the resource is no longer needed.

evidence.explanation: First example: HttpRequestMessage is allocated, optionally receives StringContent, and is passed to SendAsync without disposal. The first caller receives HttpResponseMessage and checks success without disposing it. Neither resource has deterministic cleanup for this operation. Prerequisite: Execution of the loader HTTP operation. Impact: Missing deterministic HTTP-resource cleanup. Actual resource exhaustion or security exploitation was not established.

security.title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
security.description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.

evidence.explanation: Unsafe rendering pattern: search-index fields from HomeController.Search (HomeController.cs:52-60) and detail responses (86-96) enter HTML and generated inline event handlers without contextual encoding at Index.cshtml:313-334,397-416 and JobDetails.cshtml:49-80. Conditional stored XSS requires an attacker to influence indexed/imported data; no attacker-accessible index-write endpoint was identified. This reports the unsafe sink pattern, not a demonstrated remote exploit. Deployed configuration and index provenance were not verified.
